title: The Last Ghost
author: Felix Thornbury
blurb: Coral Dunmore, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
